generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26
Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt, orders as may be modified from time to time
Bidder has to quote rates excluding GST, GST shall be paid separately as per applicable
All the Work done certificate uploaded should include E-procurement indent number.
Tenderer has to quote same rates for the items which are repetitive in all sub estimates and if any discrepancies lowest rates will be considered

Note: All subsequent corrigendum/amendment shall be published only on website and not in press. Hence tenderers are advised to always be in touch with our said website until the tender is finally opened.

itemList.description: Removal  of  Unserviceable  Soil  with  Disposal  upto  a  suitable distance as directed by the Engineer incharge of work.  Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 301

Dewatering by mechanical means including hire charges of machinery, fuel and crew charges etc., complete as per the direction of the engineer-in charge (statement of hire charges of machinery for the year with all lead and lift,loading and unloading as per the directions of engineer in-charge of the work, 5HP Diesel pump.
UNI SR 2023-24, V-4, P-27, SL NO.25

De-silting of Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and loading the same to transport vehicle ( excluding cost of transportation ) including cost of all machinery, labour & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification.
Desilting sedimentation tank area 650 sqm, 2m depth of silt is considered for desilting.
UNI SR 2023-24, V-4, P-140, SL NO. 3.12

Cost of Haulage excluding loading and Unloading, case-1: surfaced road.
B. Taking output 18 tonne load and lead of 5 km is considered
UNI SR 2023-24, VOL-3, P-5, Sl. no. 1.4.i.b

Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m

Providing and constructing rockfill embankment with graded rubble of 400 mm and down size from approved quarry including spreading and compacting by vibratory rollers in layers not exceeding 600 mm and finishing the sides to the required slopes including cost of all materials, machinery, labour etc., complete with all leads and lifts. (For Dam and Allied works)
UNI SR 2023-24, VOL-4, III P-182, Sl no. 25

Floating Gardens
Supply and Installation of HDPE Floating Wetlands for holding Aquatic plants with appropriate fixtures including specially designed bucket for maximum root development to enable nutrient removal in polluted water body including transportation to site and labour cost for assembly of fames, plants complete.

Material specification
High Density Poly Ethylene Floats of 330mm x 330mm and 60mm in overall depth and wall thickness of 3mm.

Opening at the centre with 160mm dia at the top and 140mm at the bottom along with projections on the sides and provision for locking systems

6mm dia opening at the corners

Buckets of 170mm dia at the top and 140mm at the bottom along with projections on the sides and provision for locking systems

Plus shaped connector pin for interconnecting

3-inch HDPE pipes and elbows for supporting the floating frames

GI Wires 22 gaugue and PVC binders for fixing/binding

10mm Nylon ropes for anchoring

Minimum of 18 plants per square meter area of the wetlands.

Plants of different species for taking up nutrients from waterbody like Cannandica, Vetiver, Spider Lilly, Reed, Water Grass, Phragmites and other locally grown varieties in and around the waterbody.

DLP on materials used for 2 years
